changed_sentences: The paper reports that the proposed single BLSTM model for word sense disambiguation has 5 layers.
Section 3 One Single BLSTM network for WSD states that the architecture, depicted in Fig. 1, consists of 5 layers.
The layer count is explicit: 5 layers.
The named layers that make up the architecture are a sigmoid layer (at the top), a fully-connected layer, a concatenation layer, a BLSTM layer, and a sense and word embeddings layer.
The paper includes the sense and word embeddings layer as one of the five layers, on the bottom.
The BLSTM is treated as one layer within the total layer count; the paper lists the BLSTM layer as one of the five layers.
The model therefore uses a single BLSTM layer as a component within the 5 layers.
The explicit total layer count given is 5 layers.
